how_to_read.title: How to Read Your 2027 Personal Planner
how_to_read.intro: This annual planner is designed as a structured scheduling companion tailored to your personal numerical cycles. The calendar serves as a supportive planning aid derived from your core birth numbers and the universal rhythms of 2027, helping you allocate time with greater focus and clarity.

tiers.Peak: Days of exceptional personal alignment where your individual numbers and universal cycles harmonise smoothly. These dates offer supportive momentum for launching major projects, leading key meetings, or taking decisive personal steps.
tiers.Excellent: High-harmony days well suited for meaningful progress and constructive collaboration. Consider scheduling contract discussions, strategic planning sessions, or milestone presentations during these windows.
tiers.Good: Balanced and productive days ideal for steady workflow and ongoing tasks. These periods support consistent execution, standard communications, and systematic follow-through.
tiers.Moderate: Neutral days best suited for routine responsibilities, maintenance, and internal review. They provide a calm backdrop for desk work, administrative clearing, and thoughtful preparation.
tiers.Care: Dates calling for patient pacing, thorough double-checking, and deliberate communication. Use these days for reflective tasks, rest, and careful organisation rather than hasty commitments.

how_to_read.planning_aid_note: Every personal cycle offers natural ebbs and flows throughout the calendar year. By viewing these scores as navigational indicators rather than rigid boundaries, you can structure your weekly priorities with greater intention and poise.

key_dates_guidelines.rule_amavasya: New Moon (Amavasya) days are omitted from key launch recommendations to support quiet inward pacing.
key_dates_guidelines.rule_rahu_kaal: Days with extended morning Rahu Kaal intervals are adjusted to prioritise afternoon windows.
key_dates_guidelines.rule_near_boundary: When a lunar tithi transitions within 45 minutes of local sunrise, the report highlights the shift so activities can be timed with mindful awareness.
